6.11 rsCompilerErrorInExpression
rsCompilerErrorInExpression is a critical error that will occur whenever the evaluation of an expression
results in a compile error. For example, if an expression is set to "=myFunction()", where
"myFunction()" is not a declared or recognizable function, this error will occur.
